quote_component_guard.guard: Every visible quote card must bind exact_text to a contiguous substring of the source manifest required_source_phrases for source_claim_id, and carry that claim source_paragraph_sha256 plus authenticated_paragraph_crop_sha256. Refuse missing or changed text; do not infer support from similar wording.
quote_component_guard.visual: Keep authentic publisher mark, native date and source credit inside the Channel 4 evidence panel. Keep 42px minimum meaningful source labels, quote text, every other text-bearing object, and the held-payment latch outside the actual hosted caption band (top 1290, height 300); derive that band from the hosted spec builder, not a copied test constant. Do not shrink a whole page to fit.
quote_component_guard.causal_story: Request to change bank details stays PENDING; callback uses a number already held; showing CALL STARTED or NO ANSWER leaves PAYMENT HELD. Do not imply a pickup, verification, or release.
quote_component_guard.second_application: UNPROVEN. Do not reuse this S90 acceptance as evidence for another asset; bind and review a separately authored story and source manifest.

buzz_production_recipe: Select the spoken claim and one exact contiguous source phrase; pin the authenticated source paragraph hash and paragraph crop hash. Count a repeated paragraph once.

Make the business mechanism causal: changed-details request → verify using the previously held number → call started; keep payment held until independent confirmation is actually depicted and evidenced.
Read the native preview helper for its actual caption band and test every text-bearing object against those bounds; do not substitute a CSS override or lower test-only band.
Run a bounded silent hosted storyboard preview, inspect every frame and seam, then obtain independent eyes. A component test or hosted capture is not editorial approval.
For the next distinct application, start with fresh source text and a fresh claim binding. S90 does not establish transfer.
